verdicts.title: Closed-Form Optimal Quantum Circuits for Single-Query Identification of Boolean Functions
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study minimum-error identification of an unknown single-bit Boolean function given black-box (oracle) access with one allowed query. verdicts.title: Balancing Bounded Treewidth Circuits
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Algorithmic tools for graphs of small treewidth are used to address questions in complexity theory.
